items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] They had Happy Goldston, they called him Black Happy. [INTERVIEWEE] Not him, he wasn't, that's not the one I'm talking about.

ctx.x: Three of them, they had three. I took his brother's job at St. Morgan, that was the old one that was the game after.
They had Happy Goldston, they called him Black Happy.
Not him, he wasn't, that's not the one I'm talking about.
